shortDescription: Add and remove deb822 formatted repositories

options.name: allow_downgrade_to_insecure
options.description: Allow downgrading a package that was previously authenticated but is no longer authenticated.

options.name: allow_insecure
options.description: Allow insecure repositories.

options.name: allow_weak
options.description: Allow repositories signed with a key using a weak digest algorithm.

options.name: architectures
options.description: Architectures to search within repository.

options.name: by_hash
options.description: Controls if APT should try to acquire indexes via a URI constructed from a hashsum of the expected file instead of using the well-known stable filename of the index.

options.name: check_date
options.description: Controls if APT should consider the machine's time correct and hence perform time related checks, such as verifying that a Release file is not from the future.

options.name: check_valid_until
options.description: Controls if APT should try to detect replay attacks.

options.name: components
options.description: Components specify different sections of one distribution version present in a C(Suite).

options.name: date_max_future
options.description: Controls how far from the future a repository may be.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Tells APT whether the source is enabled or not.

options.name: inrelease_path
options.description: Determines the path to the C(InRelease) file, relative to the normal position of an C(InRelease) file.

options.name: languages
options.description: Defines which languages information such as translated package descriptions should be downloaded.

options.name: mode
options.description: The octal mode for newly created files in C(sources.list.d).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the repo. Specifically used for C(X-Repolib-Name) and in naming the repository and signing key files.

options.name: pdiffs
options.description: Controls if APT should try to use C(PDiffs) to update old indexes instead of downloading the new indexes entirely.

options.name: signed_by
options.description: Either a URL to a GPG key, absolute path to a keyring file, one or more fingerprints of keys either in the C(trusted.gpg) keyring or in the keyrings in the C(trusted.gpg.d/) directory, or an ASCII armored GPG public key block.

options.name: state
options.description: A source string state.

options.name: suites
options.description: Suite can specify an exact path in relation to the URI(s) provided, in which case the Components: must be omitted and suite must end with a slash (C(/)). Alternatively, it may take the form of a distribution version (for example a version codename like C(disco) or C(artful)). If the suite does not specify a path, at least one component must be present.

options.name: targets
options.description: Defines which download targets apt will try to acquire from this source.

options.name: trusted
options.description: Decides if a source is considered trusted or if warnings should be raised before, for example packages are installed from this source.

options.name: types
options.description: Which types of packages to look for from a given source; either binary V(deb) or source code V(deb-src).

options.name: uris
options.description: The URIs must specify the base of the Debian distribution archive, from which APT finds the information it needs.
